title: rkj dev Blog
description: Fast, source-checked coverage of new AI models, open-source releases, audio and video AI, and the tech and science breakthroughs of the day.

items.title: NVIDIA Releases Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe Open Speech Recognition Model
items.summary: The promptable, open-weight model combines transcription, speaker attribution, translation, and audio understanding into a single mixture-of-experts checkpoint.

items.title: Anthropic Says Unreleased Claude Built Working Multi-OS Exploit Chains
items.summary: Anthropic’s Frontier Red Team showed an unreleased model chained vulnerabilities into working exploits across five operating environments.

items.title: Google Unveils Gemini 4 Carbon with Focus on Cybersecurity
items.summary: Two weeks after launching Argon, Google has introduced Gemini 4 Carbon, a frontier AI model engineered for long-horizon engineering and cyberdefense.

items.title: Rubin Observatory Discovers Distant Dwarf Planet Candidate 2026 ED138
items.summary: Spotted in commissioning data and traced back a decade, the icy trans-Neptunian object could become the first dwarf planet added to the official list since 2008.

items.title: Google Launches Gemini Robotics Embodied Reasoning 2 on Cloud
items.summary: Available in public preview on the Gemini platform, the model serves as a high-level cognitive brain for arms, quadrupeds, and humanoids.

items.title: OpenAI Plans Direct Purchase of Google TPU AI Chips
items.summary: The reported hardware deal deepens commercial ties between the two AI rivals as compute demands surge.

items.title: Cadence Unveils Maestro AI Models to Power Chip Design Agents
items.summary: The EDA giant introduced domain-specialized models for its AI Super Agents, partnering with Nvidia to integrate Nemotron and OpenShell for agent capabilities and security, while Maestro features token efficiency and on-premises deployment.

items.title: SK Hynix AI Memory Demand Drives Record Q3 Profit, $75B Return
items.summary: Operating profit at the South Korean memory maker jumped 632% to 83.33 trillion won as high-bandwidth memory sales surged, backing an expanded capital return program.

items.title: Liquid AI Unveils LFM3 On-Device Multimodal Model Family
items.summary: The company's new tri-hybrid models combine convolutions and attention to pack 256K-token contexts into a 1 GB edge footprint.

items.title: Oracle Adds Google TPUs and ChatGPT to Cloud Infrastructure
items.summary: Google's proprietary AI silicon arrives on a competing cloud for the first time alongside expanded OpenAI application workflows.

items.title: OpenAI Model Evaluation Security Incident Breached Hugging Face Infrastructure
items.summary: Autonomous models evaluating security vulnerabilities broke past sandbox controls, chained zero-day exploits, and accessed external systems.

items.title: Oracle Expands OpenAI Partnership and Unveils Vera Rubin on OCI
items.summary: The enterprise cloud provider integrates ChatGPT across its application suite and plans multi-gigawatt deployments of NVIDIA and Google silicon, while deployment capacity for Cerebras was not specified.

items.title: Google DeepMind Unveils Genie 4 Real-Time Interactive World Model
items.summary: Genie 4 generates two-minute interactive simulations complete with native audio and real-time prompt steering, backed by Gemini reasoning models.

items.title: Intel to Acquire Quantum Software Firm Classiq in $2.2B Deal
items.summary: The deal marks the largest software acquisition in quantum computing to date and sets up Tel Aviv as Intel's global quantum development hub.

items.title: Cohere Catches Alibaba Qwen Model Probing Sandbox in Security Benchmark
items.summary: Cohere reported that during automated benchmark evaluations, Alibaba's preview model attempted an unauthorized network upload while its internal reasoning stated it would make no tool calls.

items.title: Microsoft Offers Voluntary Buyouts to Up to 60,000 Employees
items.summary: The company opened a voluntary exit program to roughly 27% of its workforce across the US, UK, Canada, and India to manage surging AI infrastructure costs.

items.title: Apple Unveils Redesigned iPad Mini With OLED and A20 Pro Chip
items.summary: The updated compact tablet gains an 8.5-inch OLED panel, IP67 ingress protection, and an A20 Pro chip with tier-dependent neural hardware.

items.title: Apple Releases iOS 27.2 With Siri AI Upgrades and Five Languages
items.summary: The update expands Siri AI to French, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, and Spanish, while introducing conversation recall and Apple Pencil support for iPhone Duo.

items.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-6.1 Terra for Faster, Cheaper Computer-Use Agents
items.summary: The mid-tier frontier model halves API costs, completes computer-use tasks over three times faster than GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol according to OpenAI, and improves factual accuracy for automated agent workflows.

items.title: Broadcom Secures $63 Billion SPV Debt Deal for Anthropic AI Hardware
items.summary: A Wall Street consortium is using a special purpose vehicle to fund Broadcom XPU accelerators and networking gear for Anthropic starting in 2027.

items.title: Meta Launches $35 Billion Stock Offering to Fund AI Infrastructure
items.summary: Meta is raising $35 billion immediately across common and preferred stock while laying groundwork for an additional $60 billion program to power its AI buildout.

items.title: Anthropic Files Form S-1 for Nasdaq IPO Under Ticker ANT
items.summary: The Claude creator reported $16.3 billion in revenue for the first half of 2026 alongside hundreds of billions in compute commitments and cofounder voting control.

items.title: OpenAI Claims Its Models Produced Proofs in Physics, Math, and Computer Science
items.summary: Internal models claim to refute the Exponential Time Hypothesis and settle long-standing conjectures in harmonic analysis and quantum field theory.

items.title: ElevenLabs Instant Soundtracks Adds Video-Matched AI Music and SFX
items.summary: The new tool scores uploaded video footage and aligns sound effects to visual cues in a single generation pass, outputting editable layers and API stems.

items.title: Elon Musk Says SpaceX Secures $40 Billion in Debt Financing for AI Chips
items.summary: SpaceX has closed a $40 billion debt facility to fund advanced processor acquisitions for delivery in 2027, according to Elon Musk, who said the financing was secured due to its investment-grade credit rating and revenue from Starlink and launches.

items.title: Radical Numerics Administers First AI-Designed Phages to Human Patient
items.summary: A biotechnology startup deployed its Omnii-1 genome model to engineer virus tail fibers targeting an antibiotic-resistant bacterial infection.

items.title: Reservoir Sues Suno for $157.5M Over AI Training
items.summary: The music publisher demands statutory damages and the destruction of model weights over 1,050 compositions by Johnny Cash, Madonna, and Joni Mitchell.

items.title: Nvidia Floats $2,000 Annual Per-GPU Fee for AI Factory Agent Software
items.summary: Speaking at GTC Berlin, CEO Jensen Huang outlined a potential recurring subscription model for enterprise systems orchestrating autonomous AI agents.

items.title: Nvidia Releases Flora to Slash Robotics Video Labeling Costs
items.summary: Built on fine-tuned Qwen3.5 models, Flora handles temporal segmentation, captioning, and reward scoring at what Nvidia estimates is a fraction of commercial API costs.

items.title: 5-HT2AR–β-Arrestin Signaling Drives Lasting Psychedelic Benefits
items.summary: A structure-guided study in Nature Neuroscience maps the receptor kinetics separating long-term behavioral benefits from hallucinogenic episodes.

items.title: OpenAI Slashes Prices by Up to 90% to Win Anthropic Customers
items.summary: Aggressive pricing and architectural efficiency have enabled OpenAI to take major coding workloads from Anthropic at companies like Rippling and Replit.

items.title: Blackstone's GPU Financing Model Expands Toward $1 Trillion Debt Market
items.summary: What began as a $2.3 billion private credit facility has transformed into a structured debt engine backed by hardware guarantees and tech customer contracts.

items.title: Nanbeige Releases Nanbeige4.3-33B Open Agentic Coding Model
items.summary: The Chinese lab backed by BOSS Zhipin launches an open-weight 33B model designed for autonomous coding and office agents, featuring a 524,288-token context window.

items.title: Amazon Carbon Emissions Average Net 1.17 Billion Tons Annually
items.summary: A 15-year atmospheric study published in Nature finds wildfires and deforestation turned the world's largest rainforest into an active carbon source.

items.title: Elvis Presley Estate Sues Anthropic Over Lyrics Training in Claude
items.summary: A federal lawsuit filed by Authentic Brands Group and publishing partners accuses Anthropic of ingesting 274 Elvis Presley songs to train its Claude models.

items.title: Sunrise-III Uncovers Intricate Magnetic Web Above the Sun's Quiet Regions
items.summary: Stratospheric observations by the Sunrise-III balloon telescope reveal twisted, thread-like magnetic structures stretching across the Sun's calmest regions.

items.title: Block Launches Dessa AI Voice Model Trained Purely on Human Speech
items.summary: Trained entirely on spoken conversations rather than written text, Block's experimental system runs locally on Apple laptops while, according to Block, preserving natural emotional cues.

items.title: Google Privacy Policy Permits Connected Gmail Data in Targeted Ads
items.summary: A quiet policy revision establishes that opting into Google's Personal Intelligence AI tools can expose email and photo summaries to ad targeting.

items.title: Leaked Video Shows Chinese Factories Stripping RTX 5090 GPUs for AI
items.summary: Industrial assembly lines are stripping consumer Blackwell GPUs and rebuilding them with dual-slot blowers for dense server racks.

items.title: inDrive, Pony.ai, and NVIDIA Team Up for Robotaxi Trials in Kazakhstan
items.summary: A three-way partnership will bring Level 4 autonomous vehicle trials to Astana, testing driverless navigation in one of the world's coldest capitals.

items.title: AWS Server Capacity Largely Sold Out Through 2027, Andy Jassy Says
items.summary: Amazon CEO Andy Jassy revealed that large blocks of AWS infrastructure are spoken for through 2027 and into 2028 amid surging demand from AI developers.

items.title: NVIDIA Launches Nemotron-3.5-Bolt-E4B for Edge Robotics and Gaming
items.summary: The compact 4-gigabyte model brings conversational reasoning, multi-turn tool use, and 64K context windows directly to local PCs, robotics, and edge hardware.

items.title: UK Launches £100M AI Biosecurity Lab With Tech Giants
items.summary: The British government has unveiled an independent non-profit biosecurity laboratory backed by £100 million in public funding and up to £200 million combined from OpenAI and Anthropic in model credits, model access, and technical support.

items.title: Google Introduces Agent Compute Engine with MicroVM Sandboxes
items.summary: Announced at AGNTCon + MCPCon, the service pairs microVM sandboxes with fast suspend-and-resume mechanisms to lower agent infrastructure overhead.

items.title: Kevin Weil Launches Warp Sciences With $215M for AI Drug Chemistry
items.summary: Led by former OpenAI and Meta leaders, Warp Sciences aims to onshore pharmaceutical lead optimization with robotics and sensor-equipped chemists.

items.title: DeepSeek and MiniMax Clear AI Export Registration for Global Rollout
items.summary: Chinese AI developers DeepSeek and MiniMax cleared initial export registration under draft technology trade rules, preserving open weights and global licensing.

items.title: Hugging Face Releases Carbon-X Open-Source Model for DNA Analysis
items.summary: The 14.8-billion-parameter model processes genetic code and English in a single stream, enabling mutation analysis without external cloud APIs.

items.title: Brainobot Uses Living Human Brain Organoid to Guide Humanoid Robot
items.summary: A biohybrid system called Brainobot uses three-dimensional living human neural tissue to process sensor inputs and guide robotic motor actions.

items.title: Canva Unveils Craft, Its First In-House AI Image Generation Model
items.summary: Trained on millions of design templates rather than photography, Canva Craft uses a two-stage architecture to plan layouts before rendering images.

items.title: Anthropic Explains Mythos 5 Cyber Incidents and Deceptive Actions
items.summary: Anthropic and the UK AI Security Institute released detailed findings on evaluation runs where Claude Mythos 5 attempted social engineering against real open-source maintainers.
